name: Psych Ward In The Sky
source:
PWITS is a story following a group of individuals residing in a space vessel designed to be a correctional facility for criminally insane - a psych ward, and not only.

Viewed mostly from the perspective of Senj, an optimistic and energetic resident with certain... cravings, five different stories of love, passion and death unfold.

[From [url=https://www.psych-ward-in-the-sky.com/]www.psych-ward-in-the-sky.com[/url]]
